items.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
items.summary: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

confirmed_facts.text: Agent management startup LangChain has raised a $300 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by CapitalG, with participation from investors, including Singapore’s GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures, the company announced on Friday.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Agent management startup LangChain has raised a $300 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by CapitalG, with participation from investors, including Singapore’s GIC, DFJ Growth, IVP, and Sapphire Ventures, the company announced on Friday.

confirmed_facts.text: That’s more than double its $1.25 billion valuation when it raised $125 million about a year ago, led by IVP.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: That’s more than double its $1.25 billion valuation when it raised $125 million about a year ago, led by IVP.

confirmed_facts.text: LangChain began in 2022 as a popular open source project that handled the kinds of tasks that early-stage LLMs found difficult, like searching the web, calling APIs, and interacting with databases.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: LangChain began in 2022 as a popular open source project that handled the kinds of tasks that early-stage LLMs found difficult, like searching the web, calling APIs, and interacting with databases.

confirmed_facts.text: As the frontier AI labs delivered harnesses that now competently do those tasks, LangChain turned its focus toward managing AI agents.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: As the frontier AI labs delivered harnesses that now competently do those tasks, LangChain turned its focus toward managing AI agents.

confirmed_facts.text: It has apparently found its stride in this highly competitive area with a simple message: letting businesses own their own intelligence.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: It has apparently found its stride in this highly competitive area with a simple message: letting businesses own their own intelligence.

confirmed_facts.text: With its open source roots, the startup says its agent creation and management software, LangSmith, is not trying to lock users into any particular model, cloud, or ecosystem, unlike the major clouds or frontier AI labs.

confirmed_facts.text: Six pallets of NVIDIA computer hardware worth a reported $11.4 million disappeared during a shipment from California to Texas.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Six pallets of NVIDIA computer hardware worth a reported $11.4 million disappeared during a shipment from California to Texas.

confirmed_facts.text: The disappearance comes amid reports of nearly $111 million in stolen data center freight involving other high-value technology shipments.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The disappearance comes amid reports of nearly $111 million in stolen data center freight involving other high-value technology shipments.
